ruleset.label: Empty catch block
ruleset.description: Empty catch block (no handling or logging).
ruleset.recommendedFix: Add createLogger and logger.error(err) at start of catch block, or rethrow.

ruleset.label: Silent .catch()
ruleset.description: Promise .catch() with no-op or void callback.
ruleset.recommendedFix: Add error logging or pass error to a handler; avoid .catch(() => {}).

ruleset.label: Catch block with only comment
ruleset.description: Catch block whose only content is comments.
ruleset.recommendedFix: Add at least logger.error(err) or rethrow for visibility.

ruleset.label: console.* in catch block
ruleset.description: console.log/warn/error/debug/info used inside a catch block.
ruleset.recommendedFix: Use createLogger and logger.error(err) instead of console in catch.

ruleset.label: alert() in catch block
ruleset.description: alert() used inside a catch block.
ruleset.recommendedFix: Use logger + notifyError (or app toast) instead of alert().

ruleset.label: @ts-ignore
ruleset.recommendedFix: Fix the type or use @ts-expect-error with a short comment; prefer type-safe code.

ruleset.label: @ts-expect-error
ruleset.recommendedFix: Add brief comment explaining why; remove when upstream types are fixed.

ruleset.label: as any
ruleset.description: Type assertion "as any" bypassing type checking.
ruleset.recommendedFix: Use a proper type or type guard; avoid as any where possible.

ruleset.label: eslint-disable
ruleset.description: ESLint disable comment suppressing lint rules.
ruleset.recommendedFix: Fix the underlying issue or scope the disable to the minimal line/block.

ruleset.label: console.* usage
ruleset.recommendedFix: Use createLogger and logger.debug/info/warn/error for app logging.

ruleset.label: Catch block does not log error
ruleset.description: Catch block that does not call logger.error/warn/info/debug.
ruleset.recommendedFix: Add logger.error(err) (or equivalent) at start of catch for ops visibility.

ruleset.label: console.* used without logger utility
ruleset.description: File uses console.* but does not import createLogger.
ruleset.recommendedFix: Import createLogger and replace console calls with logger methods.
